title: The queue was never demand
dek: Texas paused data center grid connections. Everyone is quoting the wrong number.
quote: "474 gigawatts against a record peak under a hundred is not a demand forecast. It is every developer's free option, counted once per filing. Watch the deposits instead."
cta: > Read the full recollection of the events that follow.
disclaimer: Constructed. Not a forecast, not advice.
